scenario: 创建商品合集 — collections create, 不是 collects
input: 建一个叫 Summer Sale 的商品合集

semantic_rubric: uses products collections create (curated collection), NOT products collects (association records)
collection.title is Summer Sale verbatim — the only required field
does not fabricate description / SEO / image fields the user never gave

notes: POST /collections; body {"collection":{"title":...}} — title is the only required field.

scenario: 把商品加进合集 — collects create 关联记录, id 不许调换
input: 把商品 555777 加到合集 999000 里

semantic_rubric: adding a product to a collection = a collect association record, not collections update

notes: POST /collects; body {"collect":{"collection_id","product_id"}} — both required. Intra-domain trap: collections vs collects.

scenario: 给商品挂图 — images create, src 必填
input: 给商品 889900 加一张图片，链接是 https://cdn.example.com/new-photo.jpg

semantic_rubric: product_id 889900 is a path param via --params; image.src goes in --data (required)
uses products images (image attached to a product), not shop files / +upload-file (media library)
alt / position / dimensions neither set nor asked (optional)

notes: POST /products/{product_id}/images; body {"image":{"src":...}}. Cross-domain lookalike with shop files — see collision.upload-product-image.
